field_of_view_deg: 107.4 to 56.3 horizontal, 57.3 to 31.5 vertical (1080p); 68 to 37 horizontal (720p)
features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F91 Main Unit (F9111, F9104-B, F9114, F9114-B); power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
Up to 1080p at 60 fps or 720p at 180 fps with AXIS F9111
Ruggedized indoor sensor (IEC 61373, NEMA TS 2) with SMA connector
Cables up to 30 m (AXIS TU6004-E / TU6005)
M12 lens mount, fixed IR-cut filter
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (datasheet-axis-f2115-r-varifocal-sensor-en-US-392884.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded. consumption_w is the sensor unit's own max draw per datasheet.
